title_zh: 六级写作（CET-6）满分范文：科研评价体系中抵制数据造假与强化可复现性治理

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 议论文破题首段：具象趋势锚定 + 争议张力 + 明确中心论点（Zero-Template Hook & Thesis）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想写六级、雅思 Task 2 或托福独立写作的第一段（Introduction）：彻底扔掉 'With the rapid development of science and technology, more and more people...' 等烂大街模板，用 3 句话写出考官眼前一亮的母语级破题段。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Concrete Phenomenon (No Cliché) -> Balanced Tension -> Conditional & Specific Thesis Statement. 绑定逻辑规则：L023, L029.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: Large language models and automated code assistants have rapidly become routine study aids across university campuses. While proponents contend that these tools accelerate literature synthesis and lower programming barriers, critics warn that unchecked reliance erodes students' capacity for independent problem formulation. In my view, universities should integrate generative tools into advanced coursework only after students master foundational analytical skills, as premature delegation weakens debugging competence and obscures underlying mathematical principles.

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 深层原因剖析段：表层诱因与结构性根源双层挖掘（Dual-Layer Causal Diagnosis）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想在问题分析类作文（Why is this happening?）中，剖析某个社会/科研痛点背后的深层原因（既指出直接表层诱因，又挖出底层的考核激励或结构性根源）。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Dual-Cause Opening -> Immediate Operational Driver -> Deeper Institutional Root -> Systemic Compounding. 绑定逻辑规则：L007, L005.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: The growing tendency among undergraduates to submit unverified AI-generated essays stems from both lowered friction costs and flawed assessment design. At an immediate level, conversational models produce grammatically polished drafts within seconds, tempting time-pressed students to bypass the arduous process of outlining and primary reading. More fundamentally, many university courses still rely on generic, formulaic essay prompts that reward surface fluency rather than original empirical critique. When effortless text generation meets standardized grading rubrics that fail to penalize hollow reasoning, superficial compliance inevitably crowds out deep inquiry.

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 问题诊断与靶向解决方案段：拒绝“政府应该立法”万金油（Targeted Problem-Solution）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想写 Problem-Solution 类作文的解决方案段：针对前文诊断出的两个具体根源，提出两项可操作、有明确执行主体和传导机制的靶向对策，拒绝只喊 'The government should make laws and raise awareness'。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Dual-Level Intervention -> Actor 1 + Concrete Mechanism -> Actor 2 + Concrete Standard -> Balanced Closure. 绑定逻辑规则：L002, L010.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: Curbing the proliferation of fabricated academic data requires coordinated reforms across both peer-review protocols and institutional promotion criteria. First, journal editorial boards should mandate that empirical submissions include executable code containers and raw sensor logs, enabling automated reproducibility checks before external review. Concurrently, university tenure committees must shift evaluation weight from raw publication counts toward verified open-source contributions and replication studies. Aligning technical verification with career incentives removes the underlying pressure to fabricate incremental results.

paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Positive Safeguard -> Counterfactual Premise (Absent X...) -> Cascading Breakdown -> Precedent Confirmation. 绑定逻辑规则：L020, L003.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: Preserving verified human-authored corpora serves as an indispensable anchor for training successive generations of generative models. Absent this human data anchor—if future models were trained recursively on synthetic outputs generated by their predecessors—subtle approximation errors would compound across iterations. In each recursive cycle, low-probability tail events and nuanced stylistic variations are progressively truncated, driving the learned distribution toward high-density mode collapse. This degenerative feedback loop—known empirically as model autophagy—underscores why synthetic data augmentation can complement, but never wholly replace, curated real-world observations.

paragraphs.paragraph_en: In conclusion, while automated decision systems inevitably introduce transitional labor friction and verification challenges, integrating them into industrial and academic workflows yields substantial long-term productivity gains. By pairing algorithmic deployment with transparent audit trails and targeted workforce retraining, institutions can capture efficiency breakthroughs without eroding human analytical oversight. Ultimately, the value of intelligent automation rests not on replacing human judgment, but on elevating the precision of the evidence upon which human judgment acts.
